text:
Predicates:
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
BrownSwissCattle(x) ::: x is a Brown Swiss cattle.
Cow(x) ::: x is a cow.
DomesticAnimal(x) ::: x is a domesticated animal.
Alligator(x) ::: x is an alligator.
Ted ::: Ted is an individual.

Premises:
∀x (BrownSwissCattle(x) → Cow(x)) ::: All Brown Swiss cattle are cows.
∃x (Pet(x) ∧ BrownSwissCattle(x)) ::: Some pets are Brown Swiss cattle.
∀x (Cow(x) → DomesticAnimal(x)) ::: All cows are domesticated animals.
∀x (Alligator(x) → ¬DomesticAnimal(x)) ::: Alligators are not domesticated animals.
Alligator(Ted) ::: Ted is an alligator.

Conclusion:
Pet(Ted) ∧ BrownSwissCattle(Ted) ::: Ted is a pet and Brown Swiss cattle.
